about_the_game:
「Galvatein : Adventurers' Guild」 is a classic fantasy simulation game where you step into the role of a guild receptionist, reviewing quests for brave adventurers. Presented in an omnibus format, each chapter unfolds a unique event set in a richly detailed fantasy world.

STEAM NEXT FEST

Enjoy the demo during Steam Next Fest!

Verify quest completion

At the break of dawn, the guild receptionist gets to work — checking every detail to see if the adventurers did their job right.

Well, ordinary people don't really know much about monsters, after all.

Since most clients aren’t familiar with monsters, it’s up to the receptionist to deduce the target using only the details in the quest. Then comes the real work — analyzing loot, consulting bestiaries, checking maps and licenses — all to ensure the adventurer did their job right.

Interaction with Adventurers

To make accurate judgments, the receptionist can ask adventurers questions — about the loot, about the monsters, and sometimes about the people who’ve gone missing. Beyond that, enjoy light-hearted conversations and listen to tales of their lives and the many stories scattered across the continent of Eustace.

The choice is always yours

Stick to the rules and carry out your duties by the book, and the guild’s reputation will soar to the heavens. But what if an adventurer comes to you with a story you just can’t ignore? What if you stumble upon loot you secretly desire? The choice is yours — always. Just remember: that freedom lasts… only as long as the guild’s reputation holds.

The Guild Tavern

When night falls, the guild tavern opens its doors. Adventurers drop by to unwind after a long day, bringing with them tales of all kinds — from the ordinary to the extraordinary, and perhaps even a story of love or two. Cook up “monster cuisine” using ingredients from defeated beasts, and sit back as you listen to the many voices of the world.

Monster cuisine can be dangerous!

Cooking with ingredients from monsters is no easy task — they can be far too sticky, or worse, potentially addictive if mishandled. That’s why it’s crucial to understand their properties and choose the right method of preparation. You’ll need balancing ingredients, the right blend of spices, and even consider the elemental traits of the dish. Sound complicated? Don’t worry — Caul, the magical cooking pot (and your unofficial head chef), will be there to help every step of the way!

The Thirst and Trials of Adventurers

An elf who left the Forest of the World Tree after losing the ability to use mana.  A dwarf who became an adventurer despite being a blacksmith — because he fears fire. Every adventurer carries their own scars, their own quiet struggles.  These are stories of those who simply long for an ordinary day… and of the strength it takes to overcome what lies beyond that thirst. Would you care to listen?
